features.title: Multi-Objective Pareto Trade-Off Frontier & Knee-Point Optimization
acceptance: Non-dominated sorting algorithm identifies Pareto optimal points across conflicting objectives
Normalized knee point compromise detected via Euclidean distance to utopia point
Exact 2D skyline step and Monte Carlo hypervolume indicator calculated
Interactive SVG chart displays non-dominated curve, knee highlights, and hover inspection

features.title: Cross-Seed Statistical Significance & Welch's Hypothesis Testing
acceptance: Parametric Student's t and non-parametric bootstrap confidence intervals (95% CI)
Welch's two-sample unequal variance t-test and Mann-Whitney U test against random seed variance
Effect size quantification with Cohen's d and Cliff's delta
Statistical power notices alert users when variants have fewer than 3-5 seeds

features.title: Hyperparameter Sensitivity Correlation & Feature Importance
acceptance: Spearman rank correlation and Pearson correlation rank parameter influence on target metrics
ANOVA F-statistic evaluates categorical parameter importance
Summary annotations describe positive, negative, or negligible parameter relationships

features.title: Cryptographic Artifact Registry & SHA-256 Tamper Detection
acceptance: Model checkpoint and artifact registration with SHA-256 digests
On-disk checksum calculation and tamper detection
Audit trail records verification attempts and mismatch notices

features.title: Pairwise Run Configuration & Metric Diff Analyzer
acceptance: Side-by-side comparison of hyperparameters and evaluation metrics
Absolute and percentage delta calculation with direction-aware improvement badges

features.title: Experiment Bundle Export/Import & Tabular CSV/Markdown Reporting
acceptance: Downloadable CSV export of runs and metrics with optional variant filter
Reproducible JSON bundle export and multi-run import
Markdown evaluation report generation with table and artifact list

features.title: Grounded LLM Advisory Synthesis with Deterministic Offline Fallback
acceptance: Evidence-grounded trade-off explanations referencing computed Pareto and Welch stats
Offline deterministic fallback produces actionable advice without API credentials
Multi-provider adapter support (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama) with credential redaction

features.title: OIDC Keycloak Authentication, RBAC Tiers & CSRF Protection
acceptance: OIDC authorization-code flow with PKCE, state, and nonce validation
Role-Based Access Control enforcing admin, analyst, and viewer roles
HMAC double-submit CSRF protection on mutating HTTP requests

features.title: Multi-Seed Variant-Aggregated Pareto Trade-Off Optimization
acceptance: Pareto analysis API supports aggregate_by_variant flag and aggregation_method ('mean' or 'median')
Multi-seed runs for each variant are grouped and aggregated into representative variant points
Non-dominated sorting, knee point detection, and hypervolume calculation operate over variant representatives
Aggregated Pareto points preserve sample size N and evaluated seed list metadata
Frontend provides an interactive toggle in Pareto chart controls to switch between raw runs and aggregated variants
Pareto chart displays variant aggregation badge and sample size details in inspection tooltips

features.title: Multi-Metric Composite Ranking & Variant Leaderboard
acceptance: Composite scoring across normalized Pareto objectives and cross-seed significance
Sortable variant leaderboard ranking table

features.title: Automated Hyperparameter Tuning Recommendations
acceptance: Search interval recommendations for influential hyperparameters identified in sensitivity analysis
Boundary suggestions based on knee point parameter configurations
